items.title: AMD earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) reported FQ3 2026 on Nov 3. Revenue was $13.38B against a $13.06B estimate, and EPS was $2.09 against $1.94 (+7.7%). Even so, the stock traded at $487.08 (+0.66%) as of Nov 4, 12:25 PM EST. The after-hours print of $518.99 (+7.25%) has faded. The stock is down 15.8% over the past week and 23.2% over the past month, and it sits well below its 52-week high of $658.52. The market had already priced in a strong quarter.

items.title: AIMG® Sizes AI Governance Platforms Market at $12.5 Billion by 2030; Microsoft, Databricks and Salesforce Top AI LeaderMap®
items.summary: AI Markets Group (AIMG) today published AI Governance Platforms, a Special Report sizing the market for software that approves, constrains and evidences enterprise AI use. AIMG estimates the market at $3.6 billion in 2027, rising to $12.5 billion by 2030, a 51% CAGR.
